            "query": "resources\n| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'\n| extend osType = tolower(tostring(properties.osType)), av = tostring(properties.agentVersion), dv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion)\n| extend ar = iff(isempty(av), int(null), toint(split(av, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(av, '.')[1])), dr = iff(isempty(dv), int(null), toint(split(dv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(dv, '.')[1])), lr = iff(isempty(lv), int(null), toint(split(lv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(lv, '.')[1]))\n| summarize fleetMaxRank = max(ar), desiredMaxRank = max(dr), attemptMaxRank = max(lr) by osType\n| extend lst = iff(osType == 'linux', split('{ReleasedLinux}', ','), split('{ReleasedWindows}', ','))\n| mv-expand v = lst to typeof(string) limit 2000\n| extend vRank = iff(isempty(v), int(null), toint(split(v, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(v, '.')[1]))\n| summarize catalogMaxRank = max(vRank), catalogOldestRank = min(vRank), catalogSize = countif(isnotnull(vRank)), catalogSet = make_set(vRank) by osType, fleetMaxRank, desiredMaxRank, attemptMaxRank\n| extend catalogList = strcat(',', strcat_array(catalogSet, ','), ',')\n| extend refRow = strcat(osType, '|', tostring(fleetMaxRank), '|', tostring(desiredMaxRank), '|', tostring(attemptMaxRank), '|', tostring(catalogMaxRank), '|', tostring(catalogOldestRank), '|', tostring(catalogSize), '|', catalogList)\n| summarize ref = strcat_array(make_list(refRow), ';')\n| project v = iff(isempty(ref), 'none', ref)",

        "json": "> **Methodology · verified on 2026-11-12**\n> - Per-OS reference = highest Azure target, exact `agentVersions/latest` endpoint and optional fleet maximum; if the OS has no target, the other OS target can be used, identified in LatestSource. This does not establish package compatibility.\n> - A filled override takes priority over every source, even if lower; update or clear it each release. Downloads use exact versions and do not certify compatibility.\n> - Numeric minor-version distance establishes neither age, support nor security. [Release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) state the general last-year policy; the [OS policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/prerequisites#azure-connected-machine-agent-os-support-and-deprecation) provides servicing of the final compatible agent for 12 months after its final release. We do not calculate end dates without evidence.\n> - Reference OS tables are in 4 Inventory; there is no automatic support classifier. Vendor ESU does not extend the agent lifecycle. Older OS versions may require the final compatible agent, not global latest.\n> - Floor 1.61 is operational configuration: [CVE-2026-26117](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-26117) (<1.61) and [CVE-2025-49692](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-49692) (<1.49) describe Windows, not proof of Linux exposure. [CVE-2025-26627](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-26627) concerns Installer (<1.0.10), not agent version numbering. Review advisories and newer fixes; the floor is not security certification.\n> - Disconnected/expired data is last reported; functional health, local prerequisites and extension support require external verification.\n> - Personal, independent, unofficial project: [disclaimer](../DISCLAIMER.md)."
